tagline: Start a fresh AI chat without explaining your whole project again.
shortDescription: MaglaSync Free keeps a compact local project state so ordinary users can continue the same work across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini without copying an entire transcript or rebuilding the brief.
fullDescription: MaglaSync Free is a browser extension for people who use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini on long-running work, study, research, writing, purchases or business projects. It keeps goals, key decisions, constraints, results, blockers and next steps in a local project journal, then shows a reviewable handoff before the user places it into a fresh chat. The Free edition requires no MaglaSync account, AI API key, cloud backend or analytics, and never sends a message automatically.
pricingDetail: Free forever for one local project; no credit card or subscription required.
